structured.approach: Attempt 2 was refused on the same G2 points even though I re-read the four files in that attempt. The read-receipt check evidently does not count plain Read calls of non-contracted repository files, so reading them a third time would not help. I removed every file:ap_forecast/... citation from the output and the claims. The no-database finding now rests only on sources the step was guaranteed to receive: tool:repo-access, the two contracted inputs (feat.tasks, feat.design) and record:brief. The facts I had taken from the code are now cited from feat.design wherever the design states them: the configuration source (B2.2), the unchanged predict.py and models.json (B2.1) and package version 0.9.0. I dropped the facts it does not state. The conclusion is unchanged. The design puts storage, databases and schema migrations out of scope (A1, DD-1, NF-10), and the DS tasks TSK-03 and TSK-04 are pure in-memory changes. The tool view confirms ap_forecast has no database. I rewrote the output in full as attempt 3. I left out the spine-appended '[Tool result]' line, which had been duplicated by the previous rewrite, so the spine's own append leaves a single copy.

claims.text: ap_forecast has no database; no migrations exist or are required.

The feature design lists storage, database and schema migration as out of scope. The data in scope is held in memory: the paid_date key, a reject reason, the delay history, the risk map, overdue rows and CT-1 JSON.
DD-1: no new repository, service, runtime, library or storage; only the Python 3.9 standard library and Node.js 22 CommonJS are used.
NF-10: every new function is pure and in-memory, with no I/O, no network and no mutation of inputs.

The Data Science lane has two tasks. TSK-03 adds vendor_risk in a new risk.py, with no LLM, no network and no models.json read. TSK-04 adds risk=None to build_explanation_request, and models.json must not change.
ap_forecast changes are a new src/ap_forecast/risk.py, an additive change to explain.py, and an export plus version step in __init__.py; predict.py and models.json stay unchanged.
Provider, model and max_tokens still come from config or load_config(), and vendor_risk must not call load_config or read models.json.
The ap_forecast package is at version 0.9.0 today, and TSK-03 owns its version step. This is a package version, not a schema version.
Any storage or network call from the libraries would reopen DES-01; the current design triggers none of the DES-01 triggers.

structured.summary: DS-03 attempt 3 is complete. The Data Science lane (ap_forecast, TSK-03 and TSK-04) needs no database change, so there is nothing to complete and nothing needed from DBAs or infrastructure. To clear the repeated G2 refusals, I removed every file:ap_forecast/... citation, because re-reading those files did not register as a receipt. Every claim now cites tool:repo-access, feat.tasks, feat.design or record:brief. task.db_changes.md was rewritten in full with the evidence and the re-entry triggers. No open questions.
